newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil - low sulphur makes late move higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil - low sulphur makes late move higher.

text.p: Low sulphur cracked fuel made a late move higher on Thursday, but high sulphur cracked was seen a touch softer.

Physical low sulphur trading was sparse with nothing concluded by the main European buyer, but swaps rose $1-1.50 with November paper comfortably at $121.50. Cargoes heading into Italy were pegged very narrowly under $130 cif.
Pricing pressure in the Mediterranean would try to support the higher numbers, but supplies from northern Europe should counter balance to some extent the sentiment to move higher, say dealers.

"Its still warm in the U.S and we don't see major interest there," commented one trader. The market was looking a touch uncertain and could be prey to concerted effort to push prices up or down, said a trader at a major.
High sulphur cracked fuel kept its head just above $100 fob NWE with product better offered than it had been.
Although no other end-user has followed the example of an NWE utility and bought Russian straight run, its presence continues to shadow the market.
